Hi, I'm Jacob Perez, a statistics graduate student at Cal Poly SLO specializing in data visualization and analytics. Here you'll find a mix of academic work, personal projects, and research that showcase my skills and interests. You can explore my STAT 541 Portfolio for applied coursework, read my published thesis on BIRCH clustering in tidyclust, or browse some of the personal projects I enjoy building in my free time.
